headline: Brokerages turn bullish on Gokaldas Exports, Arvind, and one other textile stock
hook: Brokerage upgrades highlight value in select textiles
summary: Brokerages have issued buy calls on three textile stocks, including Gokaldas Exports and Arvind, citing healthy valuations. The positive outlook reflects confidence in the sector's operational performance and pricing structures. For Indian retail investors, this highlights potential entry points within the mid-cap textile space. Analysts expect these companies to benefit from stabilizing demand and attractive current price levels.
why_it_matters: Potential short-term buying opportunities in named textile stocks
winners_losers: Textile investors gain / unrated peers neutral
